How to crop a photo

  1. Open a photo

    Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP file up to 30 MB, or drag it into the editor. For an ID photo, use a well-lit, front-facing portrait with room around your head and shoulders.

  2. Set the crop size and adjust the framing

    Choose an ID photo preset or enter a custom size. Auto-frame centers the largest detected face. Drag to move the photo, scroll or pinch to zoom, and use the arrow keys for small adjustments. Hold Shift to move faster.

  3. Download your photo

    Check the preview and choose JPG or PNG. Select Original pixels to keep the source resolution within the crop. With a DPI setting, pixel mode exports at the entered dimensions and aspect ratio mode uses 1,200 px on the long edge.

PhotoCut crops your photo and keeps the original background. Check the submission requirements for dimensions, background, and file size.
